name: The display patch stream is not resent after a far teleport
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. SMSG_PATCH_LOADING_SCREENS (0x05F8) opens every display patch stream, so its
count is the number of streams. The Extensions DLL sends CMSG_EXTENSION_INITIALIZED (0x561) after every world
entry and keeps the streamed rows in the client's in-memory DBCs for the whole client session, so only the
first world entry of a login is answered. The client's login notice gets the one stream and the 5 s fallback
does not add a second. A real teleport to another map followed by the client's notice, past the former
ten-second resend cooldown, must not stream again.

steps.label: The first world entry receives the stream
The login fallback does not stream a second time
The notice the client sends after the loading screen
DISCRIMINATING: the far teleport is not answered with the stream again
